action.text: Task: An accepted edit to a Python artifact causes a failed reopen of the edited function. The reopen in reopen.py computes exact_text_for_unit(artifact, unit), hashes it, and compares to unit.content_hash. If these mismatch, reopen returns BLOCKED. I need to see _make_unit in artifact_units.py (lines 200+) to understand how content_hash is computed, and compare with exact_text_for_unit which does '\n'.join(lines[start-1:end]).
